cohort: The study included 40 women who died during pregnancy, delivery, or within 42 days after birth in Yazd Province, Iran, between 2002 and 2011.
finding: The study found a maternal mortality rate of 20.8 deaths per 100,000 live births, with bleeding and heart disease being the most common causes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section and its complications were a main cause of death in many cases.
